subject: A-Level Business
scenario:
Factory capacity 50 000 units a year
Fixed costs £600 000 a year
Variable cost £8 per unit
Output rises from 30 000 to 40 000 units a year.
question: Calculate the change in the unit (average) cost of production. Show your working.

mark_scheme.instruction: Award marks as shown. Own Figure Rule (OFR) applies. Maximum 4 marks.
mark_scheme.answer: A fall of £5 per unit (from £28 to £23)
points: = a fall of £5 per unit (1 mark)
mark_scheme.additional_guidance: Ignoring variable costs (£20 to £15) still gives a fall of £5: award 3 marks as unit cost is not correctly calculated. Total cost route: (£600 000 + £240 000)/30 000 = £28; (£600 000 + £320 000)/40 000 = £23 is equally valid.
examiner_principles: Award marks for correct working using the Own Figure Rule (OFR) - an arithmetic slip early on does not stop later method marks.
Correct formula with no valid calculation = 1 mark.
